principle: Advance scientific usefulness and independent adoption; do not manufacture validation.
implemented: Original-site presence model and independent oracle tests
Explicit counterexamples and candidate panel selection
CLI, Python API, portable agent guidance
Source distribution and wheel build path
Exact local primer rematching in both orientations, including multiple products
Canonical local genotype grouping and explicit uninformative result states
Model-sensitivity comparison and guarded public Python entry points

tasks.title: Publish standalone research-alpha repository and execute remote CI
acceptance_criteria: Run source inventory verification and all available local checks.
Create dnncha/editwitness with fresh history; do not merge into DotMatch.
Resolve all CI matrix and strict typing failures; record actual run URLs and commit.
Confirm package-index namespace ownership before PyPI publication; configure trusted publishing and no credentials in code.

completed_evidence.remaining: Standalone repository creation and package-index ownership/publication remain separate from public branch distribution.

tasks.title: Independent scientific review of both observation models
acceptance_criteria: Obtain review from a genome-engineering scientist independent of implementation.
Review original-site representation dependence, exact multi-product/all-detectable assumptions, primer rescue, local-window limits, dosage, paired-end gaps and uninformative states.
Record disagreements and revise model/version explicitly; never manufacture a reviewer or review result.

tasks.title: Exact edited-sequence primer rematching as a separately versioned model
acceptance_criteria: Define handling of new, rescued, multiple and opposing-orientation primer sites with bounded product enumeration.
Make physically equivalent normalized allele representations yield the same observation in the new model.
Add independent sequence-oracle and adversarial repeat/normalization tests.
Retain explicit original model selection; verify historical evidence with the package version that produced it. Do not invent mismatch probabilities.

tasks.title: Adjudicated public biological benchmark with ground-truth metadata
acceptance_criteria: Acquire licensed/public exact references, primer geometry, edit structures, read configuration and independent measurement outcomes.
Store provenance, accessions, checksums, exclusions and negative controls before evaluation.
Publish reproducible scripts and per-case outcomes; separate synthetic from biological evidence.
Report false assurances and model failures, not only successful illustrations.

tasks.title: One read-only caller-output adapter with source provenance
acceptance_criteria: Choose a versioned established caller format with real fixtures and documented semantics.
Preserve upstream outputs, sample metadata and checksums.
Never equate an unobserved allele with zero biological frequency.
Add malformed-file and coordinate-normalization tests and a runnable end-to-end example.

tasks.title: More useful bounded deletion-hypothesis generation
acceptance_criteria: Generate explicit local deletion alternatives around a user-specified edit without claiming outcome probabilities.
Record grid bounds, filtering and any cap; do not silently subsample.
Deduplicate equivalent states reproducibly and keep inspectable counterexamples.
Use actual readout-equivalence engine, not structural scan counts, for genotype claims.

completed_evidence.scope: Reference-haplotype deletions paired with a homozygous local expectation; explicit limits, deduplication and provenance.

tasks.title: Calibrated orthogonal copy-number measurement model
acceptance_criteria: Specify actual measurement uncertainty, controls, failure modes and calibration.
Demonstrate both resolved and unresolved cases on independently adjudicated data.
Use a separate response-model version and explicitly distinguish dosage from sequence presence.
Do not release a clinically labeled or perfect-sensitivity mock assay.

tasks.title: Pilot with independent genome-engineering facilities
acceptance_criteria: Two unrelated facilities use the tool on a second design without developer-led encoding.
Record actionable decision changes, manual input burden and interpretability failures.
Publish anonymized or permitted findings without invented user counts.

tasks.title: Agent and workflow distribution after demonstrated use
acceptance_criteria: Provide one real workflow integration and pinned installation instructions.
Add an optional thin MCP adapter only when requested by a real adopter; retain offline CLI.
Preserve structured errors, resource budgets, model caveats and no network by default.
Evaluate Bioconda and registry submissions without claiming they already exist.

tasks.title: Profile-driven performance improvements
acceptance_criteria: Profile exact rematching/product enumeration separately from the geometry scanner; report model and workload shape.
Collect reproducible workloads with environment, dataset and baseline metadata.
Optimize only demonstrated bottlenecks; retain independent oracle agreement.
Add a native extension only with portable wheels and measurable user benefit.
Do not trade evidence completeness for speed without an explicit versioned approximation.
